description: This Java source file defines the class ParseAndValidator, which provides utility methods for extracting JSON objects from commands and for handling validation errors within the Apache Fineract infrastructure.

classes.name: ParseAndValidator
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to parse JSON objects from commands and to throw exceptions if validation errors are present.

methods.name: extractJsonObject
methods.description: Extracts a JsonObject from a JsonCommand, throwing an InvalidJsonException if the JSON is blank or invalid.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Checks for validation errors in a DataValidatorBuilder and throws a PlatformApiDataValidationException if errors are found.
